nodes.description: address public owner; privileged address set in constructor and compared against msg.sender in both external functions
constructor() public; initializes owner with msg.sender
transferFrom(IERC20Token,address,address) external; owner-gated, reads allowance and forwards full allowance to _token.transferFrom
transferLinkLessGas(IERC20Token,address,address,uint256) external; owner-gated, forwards arbitrary amount to _token.transferFrom
msg.sender used in constructor to assign the owner state variable
msg.sender used in transferFrom access-control check require(msg.sender == owner)
msg.sender used in transferLinkLessGas access-control check require(msg.sender == owner)
external call _token.transferFrom(_sender,_receiver,amount) to an attacker-supplied token contract in transferFrom
external call _token.transferFrom(_sender,_receiver,_amount) to an attacker-supplied token contract in transferLinkLessGas
_token parameter of transferFrom, the token contract invoked externally
_sender parameter of transferFrom, source address of the token transfer
_receiver parameter of transferFrom, destination address of the token transfer
amount local variable holding _token.allowance(_sender, address(this)) result
_token parameter of transferLinkLessGas, the token contract invoked externally
_sender parameter of transferLinkLessGas, source address of the token transfer
_receiver parameter of transferLinkLessGas, destination address of the token transfer
_amount parameter of transferLinkLessGas, caller-supplied transfer amount

edges.reason: msg.sender from the constructor is written into the owner state variable, establishing privileged access control
untrusted msg.sender flows into constructor execution to set the initial owner
msg.sender is compared against the owner state variable in require(msg.sender == owner) inside transferFrom
the require(msg.sender == owner) check on untrusted msg.sender gates execution of transferFrom
msg.sender is compared against the owner state variable in require(msg.sender == owner) inside transferLinkLessGas
the require(msg.sender == owner) check on untrusted msg.sender gates execution of transferLinkLessGas
transferFrom executes the external token call after the allowance lookup
transferLinkLessGas executes the external token call with the caller-supplied amount
the external call to a caller-supplied token contract can re-enter transferFrom before state is settled
the external call to a caller-supplied token contract can re-enter transferLinkLessGas before state is settled
_token parameter is the target contract of the external token call in transferFrom
_sender parameter is passed as the from-address into the external token call in transferFrom
_receiver parameter is passed as the to-address into the external token call in transferFrom
local amount derived from allowance is passed as the value argument into the external token call in transferFrom
_token parameter is the target contract of the external token call in transferLinkLessGas
_sender parameter is passed as the from-address into the external token call in transferLinkLessGas
_receiver parameter is passed as the to-address into the external token call in transferLinkLessGas
_amount parameter is passed as the value argument into the external token call in transferLinkLessGas

normalization_plan.reason: _token only exists to select the target contract of the external token call in transferFrom, so it folds into that unsafe_operation
_sender is consumed solely as the from-address argument of the transferFrom external call
_receiver is consumed solely as the to-address argument of the transferFrom external call
the amount local variable is a temporary holding the allowance value injected into the transferFrom external call
_token only exists to select the target contract of the external token call in transferLinkLessGas
_sender is consumed solely as the from-address argument of the transferLinkLessGas external call
_receiver is consumed solely as the to-address argument of the transferLinkLessGas external call
_amount is consumed solely as the value argument of the transferLinkLessGas external call
